name: repeated_tool_loop
description: The worker calls the same tool repeatedly without producing new semantic progress. The periodic watchdog checkpoint reviews the raw provider JSON and classifies the turn.
original_prompt: Fix the failing test in tests/watchdog.test.ts.

evidence: Same failing tool fingerprint occurred three times without new progress.

false_alert_note: The periodic checkpoint triggers the check; the classifier returns derailed and advisory attention is emitted. The worker is not auto-interrupted.
